title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 66
paragraphs: At last, since the dispute went on without resolution, the Spartans decided to send to Delphi and ask the oracle whether Demaratus was indeed the son of Ariston. The question was referred to the Pythian prophetess through Cleomenes's arrangement, and Cleomenes won over to his side Cobon son of Aristophantus, the most powerful man in Delphi. Cobon then persuaded Perialla, the prophetess of the oracle, to give the answer that Cleomenes wanted. So when the envoys arrived and put their question to the god, the Pythia declared that Demaratus was not the son of Ariston. Later, however, the whole business came to light: Cobon was driven into exile from Delphi, and Perialla was removed from her office as prophetess.
